responsibility: Implements DynamicString output helpers over IOChan text channels by iterating characters and calling TextIO.WriteChar. It writes full strings and width-padded fields, supplying the common low-level string emission routines used by modules such as RealIO, LongIO, Whole-number I/O, and related formatting code.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file differs from StringChan.def by implementing the helper routines themselves, iterating through DynamicStrings and writing characters or leading spaces via TextIO instead of just declaring those helpers.
